However, it was not over yet.
After smashing the divine pearl apart, the giant thunder-element palm was actually completely undamaged.
It continued descending toward Vakado with overwhelming force.
Boom—!
Vakado wanted to dodge, but then he saw the giant palm suddenly accelerate.
It was like a mountain descending from the sky, completely covering him beneath it.
Crackle, crackle—!
"Ah—no!"
Lightning raged wildly.
Thunderfire scattered in every direction.
By the time the giant palm dispersed...
Vakado’s figure was already gone!
[Ding!
You have killed the Godkin powerhouse [Vakado].
You have obtained [Divine Blood] ×1, [Divine Soul] ×1, [Divine Bone] ×1, [Primal Spirit] ×1 point, gold coins +6.42 million...]
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
He immediately began operating the system.
[Ding!
You have sold [Divine Blood] ×1, [Divine Soul] ×1, [Divine Bone] ×1, and [Primal Spirit] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold items are special materials.
Please choose quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
Listening to the system prompt, Daniel chose quantity boost for everything.
Divine Blood, Divine Soul, Divine Bone—
These were all precious materials used to fill the [Reincarnation Sacred Spring].
As for Primal Spirit, that was an even more important resource!
He was still counting on gathering ten billion points of Primal Spirit to deduce that legendary forbidden technique!
[Ding!
Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained [Divine Blood] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding!
Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained [Divine Soul] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding!
Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained [Divine Bone] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding!
Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained [Primal Spirit] ×1,000,000 points!]
The moment Vakado died, the young Godkin were all shocked.
Instant kill!
"This human guy really isn’t simple!"
What made them feel even more uneasy was that this person was only legendary-grade!
If he were allowed to break through to the supreme-grade realm in the future...
Wouldn’t that be terrifying?
For a moment, the expressions of all the young Godkin present darkened.
"In the entire Skyvault Corridor, there are probably no more than five people who can instantly kill Vakado in one move."
"Vakado died way too miserably...
That human was clearly hiding something."
"Who’s going next?"
"My strength is about the same as Vakado’s, so I won’t go up there and throw my life away."
"Same here.
Besides, I still have to control the Void Eye and broadcast the battle details back to Skyvault Corridor in real time.
It’s not convenient for me to fight."
"Hmph.
All excuses.
You’re simply embarrassing the Godkin!
I’ll do it!"
Skyvault Corridor.
This was the most prestigious academy in the God realm, with a heritage that had been passed down for countless years.

At this moment, all the instructors and students inside Skyvault Corridor had gathered together, observing the live situation of this duel through the divine artifact held by the young man at the front.
When they saw Vakado get killed instantly in a single move, all the Godkin were stunned.
Their expressions looked as if they had seen a ghost.
An instant kill—
Just how powerful did one have to be to do that?
After pondering for a moment, one instructor slowly said, "This human powerhouse is highly skilled at controlling elements.
That move just now was a lightning-type ability."
A student raised a question.
"If he controls elements, shouldn’t he be a mage?
But why didn’t we see him holding a staff?"
As soon as those words came out, the instructor was directly stumped.
For a while, he could not answer.
"Ahem..."
Another instructor hurriedly stepped forward to smooth things over.
"The Endless Starfield is vast.
There are all kinds of strange and unusual abilities out there."
"Just because we don’t understand something doesn’t mean it doesn’t exist.
In my opinion, although this person is only legendary-grade, he must have used some ancient secret technique to raise the power of his skills to this level."
Only then did the students feel that this explanation made sense.
"Most secret techniques have side effects or limitations."
"Exactly.
Then can we infer that this person is good at explosive bursts of power, but not good at prolonged battles?"
"That should be the case.
MP will always run out eventually.
As long as we can stall him and drain his MP, we’ll have a chance to win."
When the instructors heard the students’ analysis, they were rather gratified.
This was precisely the meaning behind conducting this real-time battlefield observation!
"Let Harris take the next match.
He’s quick-witted and strong.
He should be able to see through this human’s weakness."
"As long as Harris lasts until his MP is exhausted, he’ll be able to counterkill him."
"In this match, our odds of victory are above fifty percent."
On the battlefield, another young Godkin stepped forward.
His entire body exuded a shrewd aura.
His eyes sized Daniel up again and again, like a hunting hawk locking onto a rabbit.
"Godkin, Skyvault Corridor—Harris!"
Daniel did not speak.
Inwardly, he was already starting to feel annoyed.
These Godkin were so tedious, coming one after another.
How long were they planning to keep fighting like this?
It would be better to make things simple and settle them all at once.
Thinking of this, Daniel shook his head and said indifferently,
"Too troublesome.
All of you can come at me together."
As soon as these words came out, all the young Godkin froze.
This...
Wasn’t this far too arrogant?
He wanted a group of supreme-grade powerhouses to attack him together?
Wasn’t this the same as completely looking down on Skyvault Corridor and all of them, the Godkin geniuses?
"Impudent!"
Harris felt that he had been deeply humiliated.
He was so angry that he actually laughed.
"Get past me first before you say that!"
"Divine Domain—rise!"
Boom—!
A rift suddenly tore open in the void, and an enormous island flew out from within the crack with a thunderous rumble.
The island was absurdly huge, almost as large as one of the human race’s main cities.
The aura it released was far stronger than that of the previous Godkin youth by an unknown amount!
Harris had been thoroughly enraged by Daniel.
After summoning his Divine Domain island, he charged fiercely toward Daniel together with the island.
For a moment, the entire space began to shake.
It was like the sea in the midst of a storm, as though it might collapse at any second.
Behind him, the young Godkin cried out in surprise one after another.
"Harris was actually hiding this much strength!"
"So he never used his full power in those sparring matches inside the Corridor!"
"What a Harris...
This time, he might really be able to win!"

chapters.title: Chapter 209 -209-Gods Born to Stand at the Pinnacle
paragraphs: Skyvault Corridor.
The instructors and students also witnessed this scene.
One instructor could not help but exclaim, "Harris’s strength has actually reached this level!"
"The strength he is displaying now is absolutely enough to rank in the top five of Skyvault Corridor!"
"Harris’s Divine Domain can both attack and defend. It can suppress enemies while protecting himself. Its battle power is limitless..."
"If nothing unexpected happens, Harris is certain to win!"
Yet there was not the slightest expression on Daniel’s face.
He slowly raised his hand and softly spoke a single sentence.
His voice was not loud, yet it sounded like some ancient incantation, carrying a Strength that permitted no doubt.
"Let there be—"
"Light in this world!"
Epic-grade forbidden spell · Arrow of Judgment!
The moment his words fell, a ball of dazzling white light condensed in his palm, like a sealed sun desperately struggling free of its chains.
The light grew brighter and brighter, fiercer and fiercer, illuminating the entire battlefield until it was almost blinding.
It was as if nothing else existed between heaven and earth.
Only that light remained—
The light of judgment that was about to tear everything apart!
That radiance was gentle yet scorching, like compressed dawn.
Daniel lightly pushed that holy light forward.
Buzz, buzz—!
Boom—!
The holy light abruptly erupted into a massive pillar of radiance.
The speed of that pillar was unimaginably fast. In an instant, it pierced through both Harris and his Divine Domain.
The light was so intense that no one could look directly at it.
For a moment, all the young Godkin shut their eyes one after another, as though they were staring straight into the blazing sun.
That holy light came quickly.
And it vanished just as quickly.
When the radiance dissipated, Harris’s figure, along with his Divine Domain, had already disappeared without a trace.
Harris had fallen!
Another instant kill!
[Ding! You have killed the Godkin powerhouse [Harris]. You have obtained [Divine Blood] ×1, [Divine Soul] ×1, [Divine Bone] ×1, [Primal Spirit] ×1 point, gold coins +6.12 million...]
The corners of Daniel’s mouth rose.
[Ding! You have sold [Divine Blood] ×1, [Divine Soul] ×1, [Divine Bone] ×1, and [Primal Spirit] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 4 gold coins!
You have obtained [Divine Blood] ×1,000,000,
[Divine Soul] ×1,000,000,
[Divine Bone] ×1,000,000,
[Primal Spirit] ×1,000,000 points!]
"Hiss—!"
The young Godkin were completely stunned.
Daniel had actually killed Harris instantly—
What was going on?
The instructors and students of Skyvault Corridor were stunned as well. Their understanding of reality was practically on the verge of collapse.
Harris—
One of Skyvault Corridor’s top elites.
A once-in-a-century talent in the mouths of those Divine Mentors and instructors!
Yet the way he fell was no different from Vakado.
Instant kill!
Clean and absolute.
And the human powerhouse opposite him was merely legendary-grade.
Legendary-grade...
Could actually be powerful to this extent?
This was simply crushing their understanding of the world.
Just moments ago, they had still been discussing how powerful Harris was, saying that victory was already within reach.
In the blink of an eye, reality had slapped them hard across the face.
Embarrassment and horror surfaced on everyone’s faces.
"This human... is simply a monster!"
"In my opinion, unless a peak supreme-grade powerhouse appears, I’m afraid no one can suppress him."
"It’s over. This time, they might all be wiped out..."
The young Godkin in front of Daniel were staring so hard their eyes almost popped out.
Harris had been the strongest among them.
And just like that, he was gone?
Then what were they supposed to fight with?
Charging up again would be no different from delivering themselves to death.
Daniel looked at the shocked expressions on the faces of these young Godkin and shook his head.
He had already told them to attack together.
Yet they had refused to believe him.
A bunch of weaklings!
"Hurry! Notify the Demonbane Knight!"
"No need. They’re already here!"
"What? They’re already here? That fast?"
"Then everything is fine now. With the Demonbane Knight here, that human madman won’t stay arrogant for long."
At the same time...
At the edge of Daniel’s vision, the figure of an army appeared.
It was an iron torrent formed from a hundred Godkin knights—
Demonbane Knight!
Daniel merely swept a brief glance over them, and his eyelids twitched violently.
Even the lowest-ranking warrior in this army possessed the strength of a supreme-grade transcendent.
The vast majority of them were even supreme-grade Transcendent Peak!
Was this the foundation of the God realm?
Innate Godkin!
From the moment they were born into this world, they stood above all living beings.
The angel race had merely just touched the threshold of being an innate race. An adult angel could barely step into legendary-grade.
But the Godkin left the angel race far behind.
Godkin children were born at epic-grade!
As they grew older, they would become stronger and stronger. Most of them could reach the peak of legendary-grade.
With just a little tempering, they could easily advance to supreme-grade.
This was a true innate race!
The moment they opened their eyes, they were already standing at a finish line that countless races could never reach even after exhausting their entire lives.
Otherwise, what right did they have to be called gods?
This was the foundation that allowed the Godkin to rule over more than a dozen planes.
The God realm was a great world.
The living beings nurtured by a great world were born with halos of glory.
However, the laws of the universe were relatively fair.
Corresponding to their naturally high starting point was the Godkin’s extremely low birth rate!
Their population had never been large. Even after accumulating numbers over countless years, they had only gathered around ten billion citizens.
For a dignified great world to have only ten billion people was truly not much.
Tiny Earth alone had several billion people.
The players and natives of Aetheria combined had already exceeded ten billion, and that was only a small world.
Compared side by side, the Godkin’s population of ten billion seemed rather shabby instead.
It could be said that every single Godkin citizen was an irreplaceable treasure.
"Innate race..."
In Daniel’s eyes, they were still nothing special.
The potential of players was not inferior to these so-called innate races.
In some aspects, players were even superior.
So while he was surprised, a different thought also rose in his mind.
A faint green light appeared deep in Daniel’s eyes.
In his vision, wasn’t this army simply a moving treasure vault?
The Primal Spirits of a hundred Godkin warriors, after being enhanced by Millionfold Boost, would easily amount to one hundred million Primal Spirit!
As long as he took down this army, he would be able to accumulate the ten billion Primal Spirit needed to deduce the forbidden technique!
The moment the Demonbane Knight appeared, the young Godkin immediately let out long sighs of relief.
The instructors and students of Skyvault Corridor also began discussing excitedly.
"The Demonbane Knight is one of the five great special forces of our Godkin. With the power of their battle formation, they can easily unleash combat power approaching Divine-grade."
"The terrifying part of the Demonbane Knight does not lie in the fact that they are supreme-grade peak, but in their frightening endurance in battle!"
"Exactly. When the Immortal Singularities of a hundred supreme-grade powerhouses gather into an ocean, that kind of Strength will slaughter any ordinary powerhouse no matter how many come."
The Godkin students were also greatly encouraged.
"Look! The Demonbane Knight has begun burning their Immortal Singularities!"
"They’re going all out from the very start? Ruthless enough!"
"This time, it should be stable. That human madman won’t be able to escape his doom."
"Another battle without the slightest suspense!"

chapters.title: Chapter 210 -210-The Source of Faustus’s Arrogance
paragraphs: Rumble—!
The Demonbane Knight Order came to an abrupt halt.
At the same time, a hundred supreme-grade knights ignited their Immortal Singularities.
Golden flames surged from every warrior, linking together into a vast sea of fire, like a fallen sun blazing upon the earth.
Daniel’s pupils contracted slightly.
He was secretly startled. "That ruthless? Going this hard from the very first move?"
At the same time, the battle intent within him began to soar wildly.
Before him now stood a hundred transcendent supreme-grade warriors, each one burning their Immortal Singularity with reckless abandon!
But so what?
Daniel showed not the slightest trace of fear.
Forget a hundred supreme-grades—even if there were ten billion of them...
He would still see them as sheep waiting for slaughter.
Numbers meant nothing to him.
Unless he encountered a true supreme powerhouse—
For example, a sage!
Sizzle—!
Just then, the void tore open.
A spatial rift split across heaven and earth like a wound cleaved by a giant axe.
Golden light poured out from the rift, illuminating the entire wasteland as brightly as day.
A golden giant stepped out from within.
It strode through the air, and with every step, space trembled with rippling waves, like wrinkled parchment groaning under an unbearable weight.
One had to understand that the God Realm was a great world.
Its space was incomparably stable.
Yet from the moment this golden giant appeared, this stretch of heaven and earth was no longer able to remain steady.
The hundred warriors of the Demonbane Knight Order burned their Immortal Singularities at the same time. Golden flames surged from each of them, merging into a vast sea of blazing fire.
Those flames seemed to be drawn by invisible channels, streaming endlessly into the golden giant’s body, becoming the foundation of its existence and the fuel for its movement.
This giant was none other than the Divine Domain summoned by the Demonbane Knight Order!
A war colossus condensed from the combined power of a hundred transcendent supreme-grade warriors!
Its battle power had already approached the level of a Divine-grade powerhouse!
And yet, this was still not the end.
Riiip... riiip...
In the void behind them, rift after rift was violently torn open.
One golden giant after another stepped out from within!
In the blink of an eye, a full one hundred golden giants stood in the void before Daniel!
At the same time, squad after squad of Godkin warriors emerged from the rifts.
A terrifying pressure, almost tangible in its intensity, bore down on Daniel with suffocating force!
The students of Skyvault Corridor looked up at those towering golden giants that seemed to prop up heaven and earth. Their faces were filled with excitement and pride.
"Demonbane Colossi! A full one hundred colossi!"
"In other words, the Demonbane Knight Order deployed ten thousand warriors this time... Hiss!"
"With these colossi holding the field, I refuse to believe that human called Faustus can still keep jumping around!"
"This battle has already lost all suspense."
Inside the lecture hall of Skyvault Corridor, the instructors were also nodding repeatedly, their eyes filled with solemnity.
"The legends surrounding this knight order have been passed down for thousands of years. Today, the Demonbane Colossi have finally appeared before us in the flesh."
"So this is what the colossi recorded in divine history looked like... In the past, I only heard others speak of them. Today, I have finally seen them with my own eyes."
"For that human to die at the hands of these colossi can be considered a fitting end to his short and arrogant legend."
The Temple of the God of Light.
A massive mirror hovered in midair, like a window leading to a distant land.
Within the mirror, every inch of the place where Daniel stood was reflected with perfect clarity.
In truth, from the moment Daniel stepped into the God Realm, his every move had never escaped the surveillance of this mirror.
Brand, the lord of the Temple of the God of Light, sat calmly before the mirror, his gaze as still as water.
He was a low-tier sage-grade powerhouse!
One of the twelve temple lords of the God Realm, and one of the three Divine-grade powerhouses presiding over the God Realm.
At the same time, he was also the vice dean of Skyvault Corridor.
Those students of Skyvault Corridor had been sent by him.
His goal was to probe Daniel’s depths while also using the opportunity to temper the Godkin disciples of Skyvault Corridor.
The full deployment of the Demonbane Knight Order had likewise been arranged by him.
In fact, Brand had prepared even more "entertainment" for Daniel.
If Daniel could truly break through every trial, then he would be worth Brand personally making a move.
Brand calmly watched as the Demonbane Knight Order summoned the hundred colossi. At last, his gaze landed on Daniel, and the corner of his mouth lifted slightly.
"Faustus... let me see the source of your arrogance."
Daniel raised an eyebrow slightly.
The Divine Domain summoned by the Godkin army was indeed no simple thing.
It faintly possessed a trace of the might of the Sword of Divine Wrath.
But in the end, it was still not Divine-grade.
After all, the Sword of Divine Wrath was a Sacred Artifact. It contained the sacred power of a sage.
These giants, however, were merely war puppets driven by Immortal Singularities.
In Daniel’s eyes, no matter how many members of the Demonbane Knight Order and colossi there were, they were nothing more than a walking platter of meat.
Whoosh—!
Ninety-nine figures stepped out from behind him and stood shoulder to shoulder with him.
Each clone radiated an aura almost identical to the original, as though ninety-nine more Faustus had descended at the same time.
Arrow of Judgment!
Veil of Eternal Night!
Puppet of the Wind!
Annihilation Flame!
Skyfall Strike!
Thunder Abyss!
Permafrost Prison!
Daniel madly consumed his MP, stacking hundreds of thousands of skills layer upon layer.
Massive amounts of Immortal Singularity were poured into them without hesitation, infusing every attack with a fatal amplification.
In a single instant—
The sky and earth within ten thousand miles changed color.
Countless elemental forces gathered wildly from every direction...
Fire element, thunder element, ice element, light element, dark element...
They intertwined with one another, transforming into a destructive, raging torrent.
-30 billion!
-30 billion!
-30 billion!
The world-destroying range of attacks enveloped both the Demonbane Knight Order and the students of Skyvault Corridor.
The Godkin students of Skyvault Corridor instantly turned pale with horror.
"How is this possible?! Those are epic-grade forbidden spells!"
"Don’t panic! Epic-grade forbidden spells may be terrifying, but we only need to endure one round!"
"That’s right! That human Faustus’s MP is limited in the end. Compared to the Strength of the Demonbane Colossi, he is nothing but an ant!"
But they did not know one thing.
Daniel’s MP was indeed close to infinite!
The warriors of the Demonbane Knight Order drove the golden giants forward, attempting to suppress the sky full of forbidden spells with the might of the colossi.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The one hundred golden giants endured the relentless bombardment of countless forbidden spells and charged toward Daniel step by step.
But their steps grew slower and slower, and their figures became increasingly indistinct.
Because the Immortal Singularities sustaining them were decaying at a terrifying speed.
Many warriors of the Demonbane Knight Order had already sunk into deep sleep under the shroud of [Veil of Eternal Night], the golden flames on their bodies quietly extinguishing.
Even more warriors were entangled by all kinds of negative statuses!
Some fell while unconscious. Some went mad under mental corruption. Some lost all five senses and drifted through the void like living corpses.
At this moment, the Demonbane Knight Order could not even unleash twenty percent of its true power.
Daniel sneered.
He watched indifferently as those golden colossi gradually came apart amid their struggles.
As expected, they soon could no longer hold on!
As the Immortal Singularities sustaining them dwindled, their bodies grew fainter and fainter.
From solid forms like golden iron, they became translucent as gauze, and finally, like reflections trembling in the wind, they teetered on the verge of collapse.
"Roar—roar, roar, roar!"
The golden giants raised their heads and let out unwilling roars, their voices filled with the humiliation and fury of being crushed.
Then that sea of gold collapsed and scattered in unwillingness.
But this was still not the end!
Only then did the students of Skyvault Corridor realize in terror that Faustus’s forbidden spells were still continuing.
They had thought that as long as they survived one round, they could focus their fire and eliminate Daniel.
But the second round had already come crashing down upon their heads.
The third round followed close behind.
Then the fourth.
The fifth...
As though there would never be an end.
This was impossible!
On the spot, a portion of the Skyvault Corridor students could no longer withstand it. They were swallowed by the forbidden spells and completely reduced to nothingness.
Even though each of them possessed a Divine Domain, they could not endure for more than a few breaths.
As for the Demonbane Knight Order, their situation was even more miserable.
It was a completely one-sided slaughter!
A large number of warriors were trapped in negative statuses, like prisoners bound to execution racks, unable to muster even the strength to resist.
They collapsed in swaths.
Golden blood flowed across the wasteland, gathering into streams.

sentences.text: Rumble—!
The Demonbane Knight Order came to an abrupt halt.
At the same time, a hundred supreme-grade knights ignited their Immortal Singularities.
Golden flames surged from every warrior, linking together into a vast sea of fire, like a fallen sun blazing upon the earth.
Daniel’s pupils contracted slightly.
He was secretly startled.
"That ruthless?
Going this hard from the very first move?"
At the same time, the battle intent within him began to soar wildly.
Before him now stood a hundred transcendent supreme-grade warriors, each one burning their Immortal Singularity with reckless abandon!
But so what?
Daniel showed not the slightest trace of fear.
Forget a hundred supreme-grades—even if there were ten billion of them...
He would still see them as sheep waiting for slaughter.
Numbers meant nothing to him.
Unless he encountered a true supreme powerhouse—
For example, a sage!
Sizzle—!
Just then, the void tore open.
A spatial rift split across heaven and earth like a wound cleaved by a giant axe.
Golden light poured out from the rift, illuminating the entire wasteland as brightly as day.
A golden giant stepped out from within.
It strode through the air, and with every step, space trembled with rippling waves, like wrinkled parchment groaning under an unbearable weight.
One had to understand that the God Realm was a great world.
Its space was incomparably stable.
Yet from the moment this golden giant appeared, this stretch of heaven and earth was no longer able to remain steady.
The hundred warriors of the Demonbane Knight Order burned their Immortal Singularities at the same time.
Golden flames surged from each of them, merging into a vast sea of blazing fire.
Those flames seemed to be drawn by invisible channels, streaming endlessly into the golden giant’s body, becoming the foundation of its existence and the fuel for its movement.
This giant was none other than the Divine Domain summoned by the Demonbane Knight Order!
A war colossus condensed from the combined power of a hundred transcendent supreme-grade warriors!
Its battle power had already approached the level of a Divine-grade powerhouse!
And yet, this was still not the end.
Riiip... riiip...
In the void behind them, rift after rift was violently torn open.
One golden giant after another stepped out from within!
In the blink of an eye, a full one hundred golden giants stood in the void before Daniel!
At the same time, squad after squad of Godkin warriors emerged from the rifts.
A terrifying pressure, almost tangible in its intensity, bore down on Daniel with suffocating force!
The students of Skyvault Corridor looked up at those towering golden giants that seemed to prop up heaven and earth.
Their faces were filled with excitement and pride.
"Demonbane Colossi!
A full one hundred colossi!"
"In other words, the Demonbane Knight Order deployed ten thousand warriors this time...
Hiss!"
"With these colossi holding the field, I refuse to believe that human called Faustus can still keep jumping around!"
"This battle has already lost all suspense."
Inside the lecture hall of Skyvault Corridor, the instructors were also nodding repeatedly, their eyes filled with solemnity.
"The legends surrounding this knight order have been passed down for thousands of years.
Today, the Demonbane Colossi have finally appeared before us in the flesh."
"So this is what the colossi recorded in divine history looked like...
In the past, I only heard others speak of them.
Today, I have finally seen them with my own eyes."
"For that human to die at the hands of these colossi can be considered a fitting end to his short and arrogant legend."
The Temple of the God of Light.
A massive mirror hovered in midair, like a window leading to a distant land.
Within the mirror, every inch of the place where Daniel stood was reflected with perfect clarity.
In truth, from the moment Daniel stepped into the God Realm, his every move had never escaped the surveillance of this mirror.
Brand, the lord of the Temple of the God of Light, sat calmly before the mirror, his gaze as still as water.
He was a low-tier sage-grade powerhouse!
One of the twelve temple lords of the God Realm, and one of the three Divine-grade powerhouses presiding over the God Realm.
At the same time, he was also the vice dean of Skyvault Corridor.
Those students of Skyvault Corridor had been sent by him.
His goal was to probe Daniel’s depths while also using the opportunity to temper the Godkin disciples of Skyvault Corridor.
The full deployment of the Demonbane Knight Order had likewise been arranged by him.
In fact, Brand had prepared even more "entertainment" for Daniel.
If Daniel could truly break through every trial, then he would be worth Brand personally making a move.
Brand calmly watched as the Demonbane Knight Order summoned the hundred colossi.
At last, his gaze landed on Daniel, and the corner of his mouth lifted slightly.
"Faustus... let me see the source of your arrogance."
Daniel raised an eyebrow slightly.
The Divine Domain summoned by the Godkin army was indeed no simple thing.
It faintly possessed a trace of the might of the Sword of Divine Wrath.
But in the end, it was still not Divine-grade.
After all, the Sword of Divine Wrath was a Sacred Artifact.
It contained the sacred power of a sage.
These giants, however, were merely war puppets driven by Immortal Singularities.
In Daniel’s eyes, no matter how many members of the Demonbane Knight Order and colossi there were, they were nothing more than a walking platter of meat.
Whoosh—!
Ninety-nine figures stepped out from behind him and stood shoulder to shoulder with him.
Each clone radiated an aura almost identical to the original, as though ninety-nine more Faustus had descended at the same time.
Arrow of Judgment!
Veil of Eternal Night!
Puppet of the Wind!
Annihilation Flame!
Skyfall Strike!
Thunder Abyss!
Permafrost Prison!
Daniel madly consumed his MP, stacking hundreds of thousands of skills layer upon layer.
Massive amounts of Immortal Singularity were poured into them without hesitation, infusing every attack with a fatal amplification.
In a single instant—
The sky and earth within ten thousand miles changed color.
Countless elemental forces gathered wildly from every direction...
Fire element, thunder element, ice element, light element, dark element...
They intertwined with one another, transforming into a destructive, raging torrent.
-30 billion!
-30 billion!
-30 billion!
The world-destroying range of attacks enveloped both the Demonbane Knight Order and the students of Skyvault Corridor.
The Godkin students of Skyvault Corridor instantly turned pale with horror.
"How is this possible?!
Those are epic-grade forbidden spells!"
"Don’t panic!
Epic-grade forbidden spells may be terrifying, but we only need to endure one round!"
"That’s right!
That human Faustus’s MP is limited in the end.
Compared to the Strength of the Demonbane Colossi, he is nothing but an ant!"
But they did not know one thing.
Daniel’s MP was indeed close to infinite!
The warriors of the Demonbane Knight Order drove the golden giants forward, attempting to suppress the sky full of forbidden spells with the might of the colossi.
Thud!
Thud!
Thud!
The one hundred golden giants endured the relentless bombardment of countless forbidden spells and charged toward Daniel step by step.
But their steps grew slower and slower, and their figures became increasingly indistinct.
Because the Immortal Singularities sustaining them were decaying at a terrifying speed.
Many warriors of the Demonbane Knight Order had already sunk into deep sleep under the shroud of [Veil of Eternal Night], the golden flames on their bodies quietly extinguishing.
Even more warriors were entangled by all kinds of negative statuses!
Some fell while unconscious.
Some went mad under mental corruption.
Some lost all five senses and drifted through the void like living corpses.
At this moment, the Demonbane Knight Order could not even unleash twenty percent of its true power.
Daniel sneered.
He watched indifferently as those golden colossi gradually came apart amid their struggles.
As expected, they soon could no longer hold on!

From solid forms like golden iron, they became translucent as gauze, and finally, like reflections trembling in the wind, they teetered on the verge of collapse.

The fifth...
As though there would never be an end.

They were swallowed by the forbidden spells and completely reduced to nothingness.
Even though each of them possessed a Divine Domain, they could not endure for more than a few breaths.
As for the Demonbane Knight Order, their situation was even more miserable.
It was a completely one-sided slaughter!
A large number of warriors were trapped in negative statuses, like prisoners bound to execution racks, unable to muster even the strength to resist.
They collapsed in swaths.
Golden blood flowed across the wasteland, gathering into streams.

chapters.title: Chapter 211 -211-The Fall of a Legend, Fateweaver
paragraphs: The teachers and students of Skyvault Corridor were all staring in utter shock.
Never in their dreams could they have imagined such an unbelievable scene!
Countless forbidden spells poured down like a torrential storm, forcibly smashing that demonbane army of ten thousand transcendent supreme-grade warriors until they collapsed into total disarray.
Those were ten thousand transcendent supreme-grade warriors!
And yet, before Faustus, they were as fragile as paper.
Even more terrifying was the fact that Faustus’s skills seemed endless.
A divine instructor who specialized in forbidden spells was trembling all over at this moment, his face filled with disbelief.
"This... how is this possible?!"
"This can’t be real! How can forbidden spells possibly be used like this?!"
"Epic-grade forbidden spells... Those are epic-grade forbidden spells!"
"No, that’s not right either—even epic-grade forbidden spells shouldn’t be able to last this long!"
"The more terrifying the power of a skill, the greater the cost should be!"
He was about to be driven mad by Daniel.
This human had simply shattered every rule and limitation governing forbidden spells.
He used forbidden spells as though they had no MP cost at all.
Even more absurdly, his skills were endless, continuous, and unbroken!
If any one of these traits appeared alone on a single powerhouse, it might still be explainable.
But for all of these monstrous conditions to gather on one person at the same time...
That was simply unreasonable!
Was this still a human?
Forget the instructors being stunned senseless. Even the students’ entire worldview had been shattered all over the ground.
"This is a forbidden spell? Then what exactly are the forbidden spells I learned?"
"The sustained combat power of us Godkin has always dominated the starry sky, but compared to Faustus... it’s like comparing a pond to the sea!"
"The key is that he hasn’t even used a weapon. What class is he, exactly? Is he a mage?"
"If he’s a mage, then he doesn’t even need to chant..."
"This is simply too absurd."
The Temple of the God of Light.
Brand’s expression was so dark that it seemed as though water might drip from his face.
This loss was enormous!
Those were ten thousand transcendent supreme-grade Godkin warriors!
The mid-level powerhouses of the Godkin were not particularly numerous to begin with, and now, ten thousand transcendent warriors had vanished in one blow!
Pain!
Brand felt as though every inch of his body was aching. Regret surged over him, nearly burying him alive.
His eyes reddened as he stared at Daniel in the mirror, wishing he could devour that human alive.
Now, he finally understood completely.
This human was not some insignificant little character who could be toyed with at will.
He was someone worth Brand personally taking action against!

He could no longer send Godkin powerhouses to their deaths. Against that kind of continuous forbidden-spell bombardment, no matter how many he sent, they would only be delivering themselves as free meals.
Thinking of this, Brand’s gaze turned cold.
His figure instantly disappeared from the Temple of the God of Light.
The Godkin armies were countless, but the Demonbane Knight Order was no third-rate force.
In terms of elite strength, the Demonbane Knight Order could even rank within the top five!
With this battle ending in defeat, Brand would inevitably have to bear responsibility.
If he could kill Faustus as atonement, it would at least reduce some of the punishment. But if he failed to kill him...
Then his troubles would become enormous.
After all, the difficulty of reproduction was right there for everyone to see. The Godkin placed great importance on the descendants of their race!
On the battlefield.
Under Daniel’s endless forbidden-spell bombardment, not a single survivor remained.
System notifications surged in like a flood. As Daniel listened to the prompts ringing beside his ears, a faint smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
He had made an absolute killing this time!
[Ding! You sold [Divine Blood] ×10,000, [Divine Soul] ×10,000, [Divine Bone] ×10,000, and [Primal Spirit] ×10,000 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 10,000 gold coins! You have obtained [Divine Blood] ×10,000,000,000!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 100 gold coins! You have obtained [Divine Soul] ×10,000,000,000!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 100 gold coins! You have obtained [Divine Bone] ×10,000,000,000!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 100 gold coins! You have obtained [Primal Spirit] ×10,000,000,000 points!]
The pleasant sound of Millionfold Boost kept exploding beside Daniel’s ears.
A wave of secret satisfaction surged through his heart.
This harvest was insane.
Just the materials required for reincarnation at the Sacred Spring were already enough for who knew how many players to complete their reincarnation.
And that was not even counting all those Primal Spirits.
"Ten thousand Godkin warriors means ten billion points of Primal Spirit."
Ten billion Primal Spirits.
That was just enough to deduce a Forbidden Art!
Thinking of this, Daniel immediately pulled out that scroll of [Essence of Elemental Laws] from his backpack.
[Essence of Elemental Laws — Divine-grade]
Level: ???
Grade: Divine-grade
Effect: Can deduce various elemental laws and create brand-new class skills, even forbidden spells and Forbidden Arts!
Deduction Requirements:
1,000,000 Primal Spirit can deduce one forbidden spell!
10,000,000,000 Primal Spirit can deduce one Forbidden Art!
Daniel did not think much about it and directly poured all ten billion Primal Spirits into it.
[Ding! Do you wish to consume 10,000,000,000 points of [Primal Spirit] to deduce a Forbidden Art?]
"Yes."
[Prompt: Deduction complete! You have obtained the Forbidden Art — [Fateweaver]!]
[Prompt: The deduction function will restart in 30 days.]
Daniel raised an eyebrow after hearing the system notification, especially when he heard the final line.
There was actually a cooldown?
It could only be used once every thirty days.
Still, after thinking about it, this was already pretty good.
The deduction process had not taken much time either.
If it were like traditional alchemy, where a single attempt could take months or even years, that would have been truly fatal.
This efficiency was already excellent.
Fateweaver?
Daniel looked at this newly deduced Forbidden Art and frowned slightly.
He opened the skill book glowing with a deep violet light.
[Fateweaver — Forbidden] — Archer
Level: ???
Grade: ???
Effects:
After studying it, you can obtain a special ability — [Causal Power].
After studying it, your defense against [causal attacks] will increase.

[Causal Power]: Allows you to observe the Threads of Fate between all kinds of living beings and objects. You cannot directly interfere with the Threads of Fate, but you can make limited changes to the [Threads of Fate] before your eyes.
Description: A primary causal law. Deeper mysteries of the law remain to be unlocked...
After reading the introduction, Daniel studied it without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding! You have studied the Forbidden Art — [Fateweaver]!]

[Prompt: This Forbidden Art is currently only low-grade and cannot be upgraded through conventional means. To unlock deeper mysteries of the law, the practitioner’s own mastery over fate must reach a certain level.]
Daniel instantly understood.
Forbidden laws were also divided into different tiers, and the one in his hands was only low-grade.
If he wanted to study it more deeply, he would have to rely on accumulated practice and comprehension over time.
With his current strength, there was ultimately no shortcut that could let him ascend to the heavens in a single step.
He also knew very well that he had only managed to take advantage of the game system and found a clever loophole.
A forbidden law of this level was like a legendary heavenly scripture. Unless one was favored by Lady Luck herself, one would not even have the chance to touch it.
And he had merely wiped out a Godkin army, spent some Primal Spirits, and obtained this outrageously high-level skill book.
Honestly...
It had already exceeded all reasonable limits!
"Causality? Threads of Fate?"
A faint light glimmered in Daniel’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 -212-The End of Tampering with Causality and Fate
paragraphs: Daniel saw countless lines densely connected to his body!
Thick ones, thin ones, bright ones, dim ones, golden ones, black ones, gray ones...
They intertwined with one another like an invisible giant net, linking him to all things in the entire universe.
He also saw that these lines came in all kinds of colors.
Some were slowly extending. Some were quietly shortening. Some trembled faintly, while others remained completely still, like stagnant water.
For the time being, he still did not fully understand the mysteries behind them.
Suddenly, one causal line caught his attention.
It was the thickest and brightest line on his body, like a golden chain stretching out from his chest, piercing through the void and leading toward some unknown direction.
Daniel tried to touch that line.
Buzz—!
His vision changed abruptly.
He saw a Godkin sage!
It was none other than Brand, the God of Light!
Daniel suddenly understood.
This line was the causal line between him and the God of Light.
Moreover, the line was constantly shortening—it seemed to be undergoing some kind of change.
What did that mean?
Before Daniel could think about it carefully, the causal line suddenly trembled.
Whoosh—!
Sensing something, he raised his head.
Brand’s figure was already standing not far ahead of him!
The God of Light wore a golden robe, his face shrouded in gentle holy radiance.
His eyes were as deep as a river of stars, and the aura surrounding him was tranquil and transcendent, as though he were eternity itself!
"Faustus."
Brand stared coldly at Daniel.
His voice was deep as a great bell, carrying the unique pressure of a Divine-grade powerhouse.
"To be able to force me to act personally— even if you die here, you have enough reason to be proud."
Boom—!
The aura of a Divine-grade powerhouse erupted from Brand’s body like a volcano that had slept for ten thousand years suddenly bursting awake.
Behind him, countless elemental forces gathered wildly, transforming into a massive, constantly shifting halo of light.
That halo was like a world in the midst of being born. Within it, one could faintly glimpse mountains and rivers, stars, the sun, and the moon.
This was the embryonic form of a sage rank!
Daniel looked at him, then lowered his head and glanced at the causal lines on his own body.
At this moment, the main line between him and Brand was rapidly branching into countless smaller lines.
Every branch pointed toward a possible future.
"I think I’m starting to understand something..."
Daniel pondered inwardly.
He raised his head and looked straight at Brand.
"So you’re the God of Light?"
"Weren’t you clamoring about punishing me? Well, here I am!"
"Hmph!"
Brand let out a cold laugh, then stretched out his hand.
The moment his palm extended, it became as vast as the firmament, covering Daniel’s entire field of vision.
His five fingers were like five colossal pillars supporting the heavens, while the lines on his palm resembled cracks across the earth.
Then, with one palm, he struck down.
He intended to suppress this human powerhouse to death with brute force.
The causal lines before Daniel instantly underwent a drastic change.
One branch line trembled violently and shone with intense brilliance.
That was the future about to happen.
Daniel touched that line.
Whoosh—!
He saw it.
At the end of that causal line, Brand’s giant palm smashed him into a pulp with a single strike, destroying both his body and Divine Soul.
The cause was that he had destroyed the Sword of Divine Wrath, invaded the Godkin great world, and wiped out the Demonbane Knight Order.
The result was that Brand would kill him!
This was causality and fate!

With the strength Daniel currently possessed, he had no way to change the cause. The hatred between him and the God of Light had already been carved into the foundation stone of destiny, impossible to erase.
But he could change the result!
He stretched out his hand, pressed down on the causal line destined to lead to death, and twisted it.
He changed the result from being suppressed to death into coming out unharmed!
According to the original trajectory, Daniel would not have been able to dodge this palm.
Brand was a sage.
Daniel was merely legendary-grade.
Between them still lay the vast gulf of the entire supreme-grade realm.
And Brand had not even used his sage rank yet.
Under normal circumstances, Brand would have killed him instantly.
But Daniel had already learned the Forbidden Art of fate and grasped the law of causality.
He now possessed the ability to change fate!
[Divine Protection]!
Buzz—!
Daniel’s body was instantly plated with a layer of dazzling golden light, like a golden divine statue forged in the ancient past.
Brand’s giant palm crashed down.
Rumble—!
Heaven and earth shook. Space shattered.
When the rolling dust gradually dispersed, Daniel stood there completely unharmed!
"How is this possible?!"
Brand froze.
He was not surprised that Daniel could use [Divine Protection].
Although this divine art was a secret technique of the Godkin that was never passed on, and it was indeed shocking for a human to have mastered it, that was no longer important at this moment.
What mattered was...
Daniel had actually survived?
What kind of joke was this?
Brand roared inwardly.
His heart was filled with shock and confusion.
He was a sage!
When he made a move, the result arrived the instant his thought arose!
The moment the idea of attacking appeared in his mind, the attack itself had already struck the opponent.
That speed was faster than light.
For example, if a sage wanted to eat a fruit, the moment the thought appeared, the fruit would already be swallowed into his stomach.
With that kind of speed, how could Daniel possibly have had time to activate a skill?
It was utterly absurd.
Brand felt as though his worldview had been shaken.
But what he did not know was that Daniel had already grasped Causal Power.
Although Daniel still could not directly rewrite the Threads of Fate, he could already bend and redirect them to a limited extent.
Originally, the ending written on that Thread of Fate was Daniel’s death.
Daniel simply reached out and nudged it, changing the ending into—
He activated an invincibility skill.
[Divine Protection] could ensure that no one could harm him for a short period of time.
Therefore, he would not die!
No matter how powerful a sage was, before the fate that had already been fixed, Brand could not break through Daniel’s invincible body.
Unless Brand himself also knew the law of causality.
But clearly, Brand did not.
He was only low-tier Divine-grade, and had barely even touched the threshold of laws.
Compared to that, Daniel’s luck was simply outrageous. Calling him the child of fortune itself would not be an exaggeration.
The forbidden Strength he held in his hands was something not even a sage was worthy of possessing!
Daniel instantly turned off the skill and looked at Brand with a cold smile.
He had already learned the basics of using Causal Power.
His confidence surged.
Brand was still standing there in a daze, while Daniel was already delighted inwardly.
The gains from this brief exchange were enormous.
Not only had he figured out how to use Causal Power, more importantly, he had gained the confidence to challenge a Divine-grade powerhouse.
Now, he did not even want to passively endure attacks anymore.
So what if Brand was Divine-grade?
Fight him!
Epic-grade forbidden spells bloomed all at once!
Arrow of Judgment!
Veil of Eternal Night!
Puppet of the Wind!
Annihilation Flame!
Skyfall Strike!
Thunder Abyss!
Permafrost Prison!
Daniel forcibly compressed seven forbidden spells of different attributes into seven elemental spheres suspended in front of him.
Each sphere was like a miniature star, with energy churning inside it that could tear space apart.
Steeling his heart, he burned through eighty percent of his MP in one breath, stacking hundreds of thousands of skills together.
At the same time, Immortal Singularity surged out like a flood bursting through a dam, pouring unparalleled power into every attack.
Just then, the causal line between Daniel and Brand moved again.
Daniel still chose the brightest and most violently shaking main line.
Buzz—!
His vision pierced through the curtain of time in an instant.
He saw his seven elemental spheres being casually blocked by Brand, as effortlessly as waves crashing against a reef—utterly futile.
That would not do!
He absolutely could not allow Brand to emerge completely unharmed!

Thick ones, thin ones, bright ones, dim ones, golden ones, black ones, gray ones...
They intertwined with one another like an invisible giant net, linking him to all things in the entire universe.
He also saw that these lines came in all kinds of colors.
Some were slowly extending.
Some were quietly shortening.
Some trembled faintly, while others remained completely still, like stagnant water.
For the time being, he still did not fully understand the mysteries behind them.
Suddenly, one causal line caught his attention.
It was the thickest and brightest line on his body, like a golden chain stretching out from his chest, piercing through the void and leading toward some unknown direction.
Daniel tried to touch that line.
Buzz—!
His vision changed abruptly.
He saw a Godkin sage!
It was none other than Brand, the God of Light!
Daniel suddenly understood.
This line was the causal line between him and the God of Light.
Moreover, the line was constantly shortening—it seemed to be undergoing some kind of change.
What did that mean?
Before Daniel could think about it carefully, the causal line suddenly trembled.
Whoosh—!
Sensing something, he raised his head.
Brand’s figure was already standing not far ahead of him!
The God of Light wore a golden robe, his face shrouded in gentle holy radiance.
His eyes were as deep as a river of stars, and the aura surrounding him was tranquil and transcendent, as though he were eternity itself!
"Faustus."
Brand stared coldly at Daniel.
His voice was deep as a great bell, carrying the unique pressure of a Divine-grade powerhouse.
"To be able to force me to act personally— even if you die here, you have enough reason to be proud."
Boom—!
The aura of a Divine-grade powerhouse erupted from Brand’s body like a volcano that had slept for ten thousand years suddenly bursting awake.
Behind him, countless elemental forces gathered wildly, transforming into a massive, constantly shifting halo of light.
That halo was like a world in the midst of being born.
Within it, one could faintly glimpse mountains and rivers, stars, the sun, and the moon.
This was the embryonic form of a sage rank!
Daniel looked at him, then lowered his head and glanced at the causal lines on his own body.
At this moment, the main line between him and Brand was rapidly branching into countless smaller lines.
Every branch pointed toward a possible future.
"I think I’m starting to understand something..."
Daniel pondered inwardly.
He raised his head and looked straight at Brand.
"So you’re the God of Light?"
"Weren’t you clamoring about punishing me?
Well, here I am!"
"Hmph!"

He intended to suppress this human powerhouse to death with brute force.

One branch line trembled violently and shone with intense brilliance.
That was the future about to happen.
Daniel touched that line.
Whoosh—!
He saw it.
At the end of that causal line, Brand’s giant palm smashed him into a pulp with a single strike, destroying both his body and Divine Soul.

The result was that Brand would kill him!
This was causality and fate!

The hatred between him and the God of Light had already been carved into the foundation stone of destiny, impossible to erase.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 -213-An Inevitably Fatal End
paragraphs: Daniel stretched out his hand and pressed down on that causal line!
He forcibly twisted the result of "being blocked" into "taking the full brunt of this strike"!
Whoosh—!
The seven elemental spheres shot out with a thunderous roar, tearing through the void as they hurtled straight toward Brand.
Yet a cold smile appeared on Brand’s face.
So this was the Strength this human ant was so proud of?
Using attack methods below Divine-grade to deal with a Divine-grade powerhouse?
Ignorant and laughable!
Divine-grade powerhouses possessed the ability known as [Thoughtstep].
And this did not apply only to attacks. It applied to any ability.
Facing Daniel’s attack, Brand needed only a single thought, and he would have countless ways to remain completely unharmed.
Divine-grade and everything below Divine-grade were two entirely different levels.
Stepping into Divine-grade meant stepping into another dimension of existence.
In their eyes, everything below Divine-grade was no different from ants. Mere insects. Crush them, and that was all!
Brand threw a punch.
Thoughtstep.
Under normal circumstances, this punch would not only shatter the seven elemental spheres, but also crush Daniel into dust along with them.
But—
Whoosh!
Brand’s fist actually brushed perfectly past the seven elemental spheres.
It missed by only the slightest margin.
Impossible!
Brand’s eyes widened.
What kind of joke was this?!
However, what shocked him even more was still to come.
Brand tried to dodge.
But no matter how he moved or evaded, no matter how he tore through space or folded the void...
It was all useless.
It was as though fate had already decided that someone would die today.
That person had also received Death’s invitation, so he did not dare go outside, did not dare eat or drink, and did not even dare move.
He simply lay motionless on his bed.
And yet, he still died.
Perhaps he choked on his own saliva. Perhaps he was poisoned by toxins in the air. Perhaps the ceiling just so happened to collapse exactly where he was lying.
In short, once something was decreed by fate, death was inevitable!
This was the terror of Causal Power.
Therefore, no matter what Brand did, he could not avoid it.
The seven elemental spheres smashed directly into his body, all of them landing solidly.
-30 billion!
-30 billion!
-30 billion!
The result could not be changed.
Brand completely endured Daniel’s attack.

If not for the fact that Divine-grade powerhouses had already ascended to another dimension of life, where every single cell was fundamentally different from beings below Divine-grade, this strike would have been enough to instantly kill him back when he was still supreme-grade.
Even so, Brand still suffered some damage.
Although traditional physical attacks and elemental attacks dealt almost negligible damage to him, and he recovered to normal almost instantly, he had indeed been wounded.
More importantly, he suddenly understood something.
"This is... the Strength of laws!"
Brand was horrified.
"What law is it... Could it be causality and fate?"
His eyes were filled with lingering shock and uncertainty.
He was only low-tier Divine-grade and had merely touched the threshold of laws.
He had no access at all to such profound and mysterious laws.
"This human can actually use the power of laws?"
Brand was completely stunned.
A Strength that even he, a Divine-grade, could barely touch—yet this insignificant legendary-grade ant had actually...
Mastered it?
At this moment, the way Brand looked at Daniel completely changed.
Daniel, however, was not surprised.
From the moment he grasped the law known as "causality and fate," he had known that all his plans would change.
That was a law!
A supreme authority standing above countless forms of Strength.
Even if it was only low-grade, even if it was only an embryonic form, the word "law" alone was enough to crush every Strength in the mortal world.
He slowly clenched his fist, feeling that Strength surging through his blood from the depths of fate itself.
This feeling...
Was truly wonderful!
The face of Brand, the God of Light, darkened like leaden clouds. He stared at Daniel, his voice carrying a solemnity it had never held before.
"Faustus, you truly surprise me."
"I thought that your ability to kill supreme-grade beings was already extraordinary enough."
He paused for a moment, his gaze growing even deeper.
"But I never imagined that you had already touched the threshold of laws."
He took a deep breath.
"At this moment, you are qualified to be my opponent."
"Sage rank—open!"
Rumble—!
The heavens collapsed. The earth surged.
Daniel’s vision suddenly distorted, as though an invisible giant hand had seized him and dragged him into a strange and eerie void.
This stretch of heaven and earth was completely empty.
There was no wind.
No light.
No elements!
As far as his perception could reach, there were only dried riverbeds and deathly silent wastelands.
The elemental power he relied on most had fallen completely silent here.
His battle power was instantly reduced by more than half.
Even more terrifyingly, he could no longer see Brand anywhere.
All around him was nothingness. He could not even capture a trace of Brand’s aura.
Yet the causal lines told him that Brand was still here.
And that he was everywhere.
"So this is a sage rank?"
Daniel frowned slightly.
This was not his first time stepping into this kind of domain, but the previous time had only been a brief contact. This time, however, he had been dragged directly into the abyss.
"Faustus, this is my sage rank."
Brand’s voice descended from above the nine heavens, yet also seemed to rise from beneath the nine hells. It was ethereal, elusive, and everywhere at once.
"Within my sage rank, I am the sovereign!"
"If I command the elements to be born, they are born. If I command the elements to perish, they perish. Everything in this place lies within a single thought of mine."
"You—are dead."
Daniel said nothing.
He lowered his head and looked at the causal lines.
This time, the trembling causal lines were as dense as a spiderweb, layered upon layer, too numerous to count.
He touched them one by one.
He looked through them one by one.
At the end of every single line, the same answer was written...
Death!
Countless endings, all leading to the same destination.
He had no path to survival.
Could he rewrite the result?
Yes!
But every time he rewrote it, a new deathtrap would grow from the ashes.
All he could touch were those endings that had already been written.
This was an infinite echo!
If he changed it ten thousand times, he would survive ten thousand times.
But on the ten-thousand-and-first time, he would still die!
Apart from delaying the inevitable, it was meaningless.
Thinking of this, Daniel actually became calm.
He said flatly, "Divine-grade powerhouses are indeed terrifying. But if you think you can crush me this easily... then you’re thinking far too simply."
He raised his head, and his voice exploded through this void-like sage rank.
"God of Light, let’s talk."
"Talk about what? You think you’re qualified?"
A ripple of emotion appeared in Brand’s voice.
"That’s right."
The corner of Daniel’s mouth curled into a cold smile, but his eyes were colder than ancient ice.
"With the lives of your Godkin’s billions of people as my bargaining chip—are you willing to talk?"
Brand sneered.
"Heh. Your hands are empty. What right do you have to hold billions of Godkin hostage?"
Daniel shook his head.
"You don’t believe me? Then I’ll let you see it with your own eyes."
His voice suddenly sank.
"I’ll slaughter until you regret it!"
Boom—!
Daniel detonated himself.
Golden flames exploded inside the sage rank, blooming like a fleeting night flower!
Brand was utterly astonished.
Self-destruction?
Had this human ant gone mad?

chapters.title: Chapter 214 -214-Brand Invites the Wolf Into His House
paragraphs: Whoosh—!
Deep within the God Realm, above a certain Divine City.
Daniel’s figure stepped out of the void like a returning specter.
He hovered high in the ninth heaven, looking down at the brilliantly lit colossal city below.
Within the city, the Godkin citizens slept peacefully, completely unaware that death itself was already hanging over their heads.
Ninety-nine clones instantly spread out in every direction around the divine throne.
"God of Light, consider this city my greeting gift to you."
An icy smile rose at the corner of Daniel’s lips.
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Arrow of Judgment!
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Veil of Eternal Night!
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Puppet of the Wind!
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Annihilation Flame!
Skyfall Strike!
Thunder Abyss!
Permafrost Prison!
Boom, boom, boom—!
The entire Divine City was reduced to ruins beneath the torrent of forbidden spells.
Golden flames devoured streets, palaces, and towers. Countless non-human races and Godkin citizens were swallowed by the inferno in their sleep.
High towers collapsed. Temples shattered into dust. Golden blood gathered in the streets, forming burning rivers, as though the tears of gods were flowing across the earth.
[Ding! You have killed Godkin citizens ×51,878. Obtained [Divine Blood] ×51,878, [Divine Soul] ×51,878, [Divine Bone] ×51,878, [Primal Spirit] ×51,878 points...]
[Ding! You have killed Godkin citizens ×67,648. Obtained [Divine Blood] ×67,648, [Divine Soul] ×67,648, [Divine Bone] ×67,648, [Primal Spirit] ×67,648 points...]
A smile lingered on Daniel’s lips as he immediately resold everything.
[Ding! You have sold [Divine Blood], [Divine Soul], [Divine Bone], and [Primal Spirit] to Doom Guild at a unified price of 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold items are special material-type items. Please choose quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
The next moment, system notifications came flooding in wildly.
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin! Obtained [Divine Blood] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin! Obtained [Divine Soul] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin! Obtained [Divine Bone] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin! Obtained [Primal Spirit] ×1,000,000 points!]
He did not leave. He simply hovered there above the ruins, listening to the delightful sound of system notifications.
Sure enough, almost in the very next instant—
Brand arrived.
The sage rank unfolded once more, and Daniel was again dragged into that void where no material existence remained.
Within the void, only Brand’s furious roar echoed.
"You lowly human insect! You deserve death!"
"I will throw you into the Endless Ice Abyss and make sure you never find release for all eternity!"
Brand was practically going mad.
That had been an entire Divine City!
The Godkin citizens inside numbered in the tens of millions, if not hundreds of millions!
The Godkin’s total population was only around ten billion, and in one strike, tens of millions were gone!
Among them, there had even been nearly a million top-tier Godkin powerhouses.
He was not merely heartbroken over those citizens. More than that, he was afraid.
Brand had never expected that after Daniel self-destructed, he could actually revive—and instantly appear near another Divine City.
That was utterly absurd!
Although Divine-grade powerhouses possessed Thoughtstep, Daniel had gone there with pure slaughter in mind from the very beginning. He had never intended to give Brand any opportunity at all.
By the time Brand wanted to stop him, it was already too late.
Daniel was dragged into the sage rank and perished once more amid Brand’s wrath.
Whoosh—!
He appeared once again above another Divine City.
A savage grin hung on Daniel’s face.
"God of Light, come kill me!"
Daniel raised his butcher’s blade again.
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Arrow of Judgment!
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Veil of Eternal Night!
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Puppet of the Wind!
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Annihilation Flame!
Skyfall Strike!
Thunder Abyss!
Permafrost Prison!
Boom, boom, boom—!
The second Divine City was destroyed.
Once again, a vast number of Godkin citizens were reduced to ashes beneath the flood of forbidden spells.
Brand arrived again.
But this time, he did not attack.
Just now, he had lost his composure.
And the price of that had been this second Divine City.
He did not know how many Divine Cities Daniel would use to trade for every death Brand inflicted on him.
If every time Daniel revived, he dragged an entire city down with him...
Brand did not dare think any further.
He would be driven to death by rage.
At the same time, those true great gods of the God Realm would also be furious.
When that happened...
A chill ran down Brand’s back at the thought, and he could not help but shudder.
The sages of the God Realm were actually divided into several categories.
Some guarded other planes. Some roamed the Endless Starfield. Some lived in seclusion, cultivating in silence and ignoring worldly affairs.
And then there was another category—
Those like him.
Their strength was not particularly impressive, so they could only obediently remain in their home realm and watch the house.
With their level of ability, they were not qualified to guard other planes. They did not have the courage to venture through the Endless Starfield either.
As for advancement, they had not yet reached a bottleneck, so there was no need for them to enter seclusion.
Thus, they could only remain in the God Realm and manage all those messy daily affairs.
At present, only three sages were stationed in the God Realm.
And Daniel had been personally released from the lower realm by Brand himself.
Now that the God Realm had suffered such devastating damage because of him, who else would be blamed if not Brand?
This was the very definition of lifting a stone only to smash it down on one’s own foot!
The regret in Brand’s heart was beyond description.
He stared at Daniel with furious eyes, yet a deep sense of powerlessness rose within him.
This man...
There was simply no solution to him!
Daniel calmly looked back at Brand, showing not the slightest panic.
What did a barefoot man have to fear from someone wearing shoes?
With an absurdly heaven-defying ability like [Heart of Immortality] on him, Daniel’s confidence was overwhelming.
If Brand dared to make another move, Daniel would dare slaughter the entire Godkin race until not a single one remained!
Come on, then.
Try him.
Try and see whether Daniel truly dared.
But clearly, Daniel had won the gamble.
Brand had obviously calmed down and accepted reality.
Daniel understood everything perfectly well.
This sage had already seen the situation clearly.
Because Brand had no idea how many trump cards Daniel truly possessed.
That was the most terrifying thing about Daniel.
Brand would never know how many times he could revive.
And every single time he revived, he could make his enemy suffer pain that cut all the way to the bone.
Who would dare gamble?
Gamble that every time they killed Daniel, it would be the last time?
If they lost—
It would be eternal damnation.
Brand did not dare gamble.
"Now—can we talk?"
Daniel raised his chin, his tone carrying undisguised arrogance.
Hm?
The veins on Brand’s forehead bulged violently.
You call this talking?
You killed the most talented student of my Godkin race, slaughtered an elite legion, and destroyed two Divine Cities—
And now you say you want to talk?
What the hell were you doing earlier?
Yet he had forgotten that when Daniel had first arrived in the God Realm, Brand himself had never once considered talking.
Back then, in his eyes, Daniel had been nothing more than an insect he could crush at will.
Only after truly crossing blows did he finally realize that this human powerhouse was qualified to stand against him.
"Is this your attitude when negotiating?"
Brand clenched his teeth, squeezing each word out through the gaps.
Daniel sneered.
"You God Realm people are strong. I’m weak. If I didn’t use this method, would you be willing to talk to me?"
"Who are you trying to fool?"
Brand was choked speechless. He snorted coldly, his face dark enough to drip water.
"What do you want to talk about?"
Daniel said calmly, "I want to know where Queen Kelly from five years ago went."

chapters.title: Chapter 215 -215-Tracing Origins — Kelly, Deep in the Endless Starfield
paragraphs: "Queen Kelly?"
Brand frowned.
"That’s right! Five years ago, she cleaved the heavens for the first time, and after that, she never appeared again. Don’t tell me this has nothing to do with you Godkin."
Brand fell silent for a moment.
He did not dare lie to Daniel.
In his eyes, Daniel was the kind of man who was cunning, slippery, ruthless, and cruel.
Trying to deceive him would probably not be easy to cover up. If things went wrong, Brand might end up losing more than he gained.
With that thought in mind, Brand slowly opened his mouth.
"Of course... it has something to do with us."
"But why should I tell you?"
Daniel grinned, and his smile was filled with naked threat.
"Because every last one of you Godkin is a bargaining chip in my hands."
Brand’s expression twisted with fury.
But the moment that anger surged up, he forcibly pressed it back down.
"If I tell you, what do you intend to do?"
Daniel asked in return, "What do you want me to do?"
Brand snapped, "Get out of the God Realm!"
"I never want to see you again!"
For a dignified sage of the God Realm to say such a thing clearly showed that he truly had no way to deal with Daniel anymore.
When Daniel heard that, he let out another cold laugh.
"That depends on whether you can satisfy me."
Brand took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the killing intent churning in his chest. Then he said in a low voice, "Queen Kelly... went to the Endless Starfield."
"The Endless Starfield?"
Daniel’s pupils suddenly shrank.
Then he shouted sharply, "You actually dare to lie to me!"
"Queen Kelly was only legendary-grade. How could she possibly go to the Endless Starfield?"
"And besides, why would she go there for no reason?"
Brand sneered. "Do I need to lie to you?"
"Who told you that legendary-grade beings can’t go to the Endless Starfield?"
"As for why she went there—how would I know?"
"Stop asking so many questions. I’ve already told you everything I should."
Daniel felt that this matter was definitely not that simple. There had to be some hidden story behind it.
But right at that moment—
[Ding! Your class change mission has been completed!]
[Ding! You have obtained [Queen Kelly’s Message] ×1 and [Forbidden-grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1!]
Daniel listened to the system notifications ringing in his ears and took a deep breath.
The class change mission was complete.
The mission this time had been to find clues about Kelly.
Brand must have given him a genuine clue, which was why the system judged that he had passed.
There were still parts of the matter that did not make sense.
But he had no way to force a sage to explain everything clearly. Getting this much out of Brand was already the limit.
"Maybe... Kelly’s message will contain more clues."
Thinking of this, Daniel stopped pressing the matter.
"Send me back."
Brand could not wait for him to leave. The farther Daniel rolled away, the better.
But being ordered around by Daniel like this—
It felt terrible!
He raised his hand and tore open space. A gate of light appeared out of thin air in the void.
"Hurry up and get lost!"
"If you dare come again, I won’t spare you!"
Daniel snorted coldly.
"Spare me? Heh, heh, heh... It should be me sparing you Godkin."
"You? Just you?"
"Fine. Then let’s wait and see!"
Whoosh—!
He stepped through the gate, and his figure vanished into the light.
The next moment, Daniel had already returned to the human continent.
He let out a long breath.
Thankfully, he had the Heart of Immortality supporting him. Otherwise, even a hundred of him would not have been enough to get stuck between Brand’s teeth.
Divine-grade powerhouses were ultimately existences on an entirely different level.
Even though Daniel himself had grasped the higher-level laws of fate and karma, there was still only so much he could do.
He shook his head and took the rewards from the class change mission out of his backpack.
A letter, and a Class Awakening Scroll.
Daniel opened Queen Kelly’s letter first.
"Natasha, by the time you see this letter, I think I should already be somewhere in the Endless Starfield."
"I have left the God Realm."
"The Godkin told me that our ancestors came from another star sea."
"We are the remnants of a star sea. With nowhere left to go, we came to Aetheria and settled here."
"I want to find the homeland of our ancestors."

"I can’t really explain why, but in this land, I have never been able to find a sense of belonging. Aetheria raised me and made me who I am, yet I have always felt like a piece of duckweed floating on the surface of the water, drifting wherever the current takes me."
"We are like pitiful ants."
"Or rather, like puppets."
"That feeling makes it hard to breathe."
"So I want to search for my homeland. Even if life and death are uncertain along the way, even if that homeland is only a dream I can never reach, even if I die on the road, I will not regret it."
"I call this journey, whose destination even I do not know, Tracing Origins."
"Oh, right! Aside from Tracing Origins, there is also one very important matter."
"Do you still remember the story I told you when you were little?"
"Actually, that story was true. That man and I really did make a promise."
"We agreed that we would meet again."
"Unfortunately, we will never see each other again."
"I waited for so long, but I never imagined that, in the end, I would be the one who broke the promise."
"Time flows like water, and tens of thousands of days and nights passed just like that. Strangely, I never found it unbearable. Perhaps waiting itself is also a kind of happiness."
"Come to think of it, my entire life has been spent either waiting or searching..."

"What is even more laughable is that I became Queen Kelly because of that person. I wanted nothing more than to stay by his side, yet in the end, precisely because I became the queen of humanity, I had no choice but to leave on my own."
"Fate truly is a mischievous little cat. It really knows how to toy with people."
"If one day that person comes to keep the appointment, tell him for me—Kelly is already dead."
"Lastly, I wish you happiness every day, and success in both life and career."
"Your dearest family member and friend, Kelly!"
Daniel finished reading the letter.
Clearly, this was a letter Kelly had written to her adopted daughter, Natasha.
In the letter, she had explained where she had gone and the cause and course of her journey to trace her origins.
And there was also...
A promise!
The promise that Daniel and Kelly had made a very long time ago.
Seeing this, Daniel’s emotions became complicated.
"Fate really is something that enjoys playing tricks on people."
He shook his head.
This time, he did not hurry to use the Forbidden Curse Mage Class Awakening Scroll. Instead, he flew toward the Soul Devouring Vale in his memories.
Soul Devouring Vale.
A stone stele stood there, with the three words "Soul Devouring Vale" carved into it.
Standing outside the valley, one could already smell the fragrance of flowers drifting out from within.
Whoosh—!
Daniel’s figure suddenly appeared inside the valley.
He looked around and almost thought he had come to the wrong place.
Soul Devouring Vale was actually filled with blooming flowers.
As far as the eye could see, there was a sea of flowers. A faint fragrance drifted through the air, carrying a trace of sweetness.
That lake was still there. The water was still so clear that the aquatic plants and swimming fish at the bottom could be seen at a glance.
By the lake stood a wooden cabin.
In front of the cabin stood a young girl carrying a longsword on her back.

Her face was cold and stern, her gaze firm and resolute. Her whole body radiated confidence, yet she was not ostentatious. She possessed the steadiness of someone who had sheathed her sharpness rather than exposed it.
She was Natasha!
